summary: Old vs new card-recognition benchmark. The new benchmark covers 11 more supported trading card games than the old one.
summary-note: Between the two run two photos were replaced.

methodology.warmup_handling: The first 2 iterations per card are flagged isWarmup:true and are excluded from every average reported. Only the 10 measured (non-warmup) iterations per card are averaged.
methodology.note_on_coverage: Every game has 5 cards tested, except 'cyberpunk' in the new benchmark, which has only 2 cards tested.
methodology.note_on_accuracy: On main a match now counts as correct if it hits any of several accepted IDs for a card, because the same card often exists in the database more than once, differing only by edition or printing.
methodology.note_on_images: 2 photos were replaced between runs. Restricted to 8 games, the new code reaches 92.5% accuracy (37 of 40 cards) against 80.0% (32 of 40) for the old code, identical on Android and iOS.

new.note: Shared old-vs-new figures. iOS on the 2026-09-04 CoreML run scores 820/920 (89.1%).

old_games_only.scope: The 8 games present in both runs (fab, lorcana, mtg, onepiece, pokemon, riftbound, rise, sorcery): 40 cards, 400 measured runs per platform.

platform_timing_results_ms.note: Average ms per scan, warmup iterations excluded. Android and iOS are single runs on different backends and different averaging bases (Android over all measured scans, iOS over full-pipeline scans only), so the platforms are not directly comparable.

android.run: 2026-09-07 Samsung Galaxy S24 (SM-S921B), XNNPACK-delegated .pte with the segmentation model in fp16. 19 games / 92 cards / 920 measured runs.
android.note: total_ms excludes save_ms on this run; stage_sum_ms is the figure to compare against the previous fp32 run, which included save in total_ms.

previous_fp32_run.note: Same suite and device, fp32 segmentation model, build about 10 days older.

fp16_vs_fp32.caveat: Not a clean A/B: db_search also halved, which the model swap cannot explain.

ios.run: 2026-09-04 iPhone 16 (iPhone17,3), iOS 26.6.1, CoreML-delegated .pte. 19 games / 92 cards / 920 measured runs.
ios.note: total_ms excludes save_ms on this run.
